note: Visible strings that are identifiers rather than copy. PLAN §51.2 says model names are not translated; the same holds for a protocol suffix and for the example hostnames a placeholder shows. Each is in the catalogue so the drift gate still sees it, and each is marked shouldTranslate:false so a translation pass cannot quietly localise it.

cases..local: The mDNS domain suffix. A translated suffix is an unreachable host.
cases.Netplan: Canonical's network configuration tool. The Spark's own files are named after it, so a translated label would not match what is on the machine.
cases.Open WebUI: The optional service's own product name. Shown on the dashboard and on its pinned surface; the same in every language.
cases.Tailscale: A third-party product name. It reaches the catalogue so the drift gate sees it, and ships shouldTranslate:false because a translated Tailscale names no product the owner has installed.
cases.entity.subtitle.spark: NVIDIA's product name. Marked here rather than hidden, so a translator sees it and knows to leave it.
cases.spark-a1b2: Example factory hostname in a text-field placeholder, shown so the owner recognises the shape of the real one.
cases.spark1: Example hostname in a text-field placeholder. Localising it would suggest a name the runtime would reject.
cases.Ollama: The local inference engine product name, shown in the engine selector and kept identical in every language.
cases.LM Studio: The local inference engine product name, shown in the engine selector and kept identical in every language.
